summary: Citius Oncology, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an Item 8.01 Other Events announcement of clinical data presented at the ASCO Annual Meeting. The filing itself is a routine press release of Phase 1 trial results for LYMPHIR in combination with pembrolizumab for gynecologic malignancies, not a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, strategic review, or corporate action is being disclosed; it is a standard operational update.
